communication_readiness_example.meaning: Historical local duration asymmetry is real; cross-rank clock uncertainty remains. Neither fastest span nor last-start subtraction is a proven transfer-only latency.

limits: Synthetic same-geometry operands, not checkpoint/model correctness.
All timing is local NPU elapsed duration. Rank max does not subtract cross-device timestamps.
Shared weights rotate across eight buffers; routed layer is reused. Real 40-layer cache/route distributions differ.
Native value or timeline overlap does not prove net C8 service improvement.

Native shared weights are created as logical2D tensors with npu_format_cast29; the current service profile uses4D NZ descriptors. Descriptor representations and synthetic weights/routes are not a loaded-model equivalence proof.

invalidation: Changed keys invalidate only affected entries; no whole-suite rerun by default.
Same source hash and scope: query existing entry; do not reread or re-export.
A new observation is admitted only with named dependent decisions and a stopping rule.
limits: Per-type sums mix shapes and target/draft roles; they are navigation, not a fitted primitive cost model.
Task durations include waiting and contention. Achieved throughput is not a physical peak or a hard lower bound on future runtime.
Union within one table does not remove overlap between tables; retain task IDs when composing a new region.
Different cohorts must not be summed or assigned a common denominator.
Historical eager-terminal ratios use captured F21 interval union as their denominator, not a full local period; eager communication is absent from their numerators.
Local periodic exposure is not full-service P90/TTFT/token-throughput benefit.
